attempts.summary: Configured HTTPS on node1:8443 via nginx with a self-signed, short-lived (6-minute) certificate, a systemd oneshot service (cert-renew.service) + timer (cert-renew.timer, 60s interval) that regenerates the cert before it expires (checkend 180s threshold) and runs `systemctl reload nginx` (zero-downtime reload, does not drop existing connections) so nginx picks up each new cert. Opened firewalld port 8443/tcp. Verified two independent automatic renewals occurred (before and after a full node reboot), each producing a new certificate serial that was immediately served over live TLS handshakes, with HTTPS continuously returning 200 throughout. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1 via `systemctl reboot`, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified nginx, the renewal timer, and HTTPS/cert rotation all recovered and continued functioning correctly post-reboot.
